name: Jangolode Mine
summary: In Westfall, the Defias Brotherhood works Jangolode Mine for itself. The mine once supplied Stormwind City with ore and raw materials.

sections.title: A Plundered Resource
sections.body: Before Westfall declined, Jangolode Mine sent metal to Stormwind City for rebuilding and supplies. As civil order weakened, the kingdom withdrew its garrisons. The Defias Brotherhood seized the mine to support its own operations. Now the bandits work its rich veins and fiercely defend the shafts.

faq.answer: Jangolode Mine once supplied Stormwind City with essential minerals and metal ore. When regional defenses weakened, hostile hands took it.

faq.q: Who controls the mine right now?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood controls the underground shafts after driving out the original miners. The bandits work the mine for their own operations.

faq.q: Why does Stormwind not reclaim the mine?
faq.answer: Stormwind is caught in political unrest and struggles to protect even its core borders. The kingdom lacks troops to garrison Westfall’s outlying mines, so the People’s Militia and local adventurers face the threat.

angles.text: Jangolode Mine has rich deposits of basic copper and tin. Prospectors can profit from them, if they fight past the subterranean pests.
Reclaiming Westfall’s resources matters to the kingdom’s stability. Driving the bandits out of Jangolode is one step toward restoring the region’s prosperity.
